capabilities: Scan the active note for words that match definition note titles
Replace matched words with links to the definition notes
Configure a definitions folder with up to 4 subfolders
Trigger scans from a ribbon icon
extras: Manual installation only (download main.js and manifest.json from the GitHub releases tab); the listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The README says 'Don't waste time by linking every word with its definition', so the author wanted to avoid manual linking.
problem: Linking every word to its definition note by hand is slow, and Obsidian does not automatically link terms to existing definition notes.
summary: Auto-linking tool that scans the active note and turns words matching definition notes into links to those notes.
